text.description_html:
Locking Deadbolts

Security door deadbolts available is Single Cylinder (Keyed outside and thumb turn inside), Double Cylinder (Keyed both outside and inside), Turnbolts (Thumb turn inside), Keypad Entry and Gatelatch (for gate doors) deadbolts, from all the top door hardware manufactures.

seo.title: Deadbolts
seo.description: Single cylinder deadbolts, double cylinder deadbolts, keypad deadbolts, gatelatch deadbolts and turnbolts. We offer many styles in different finish colors from all the top manufactures including Schlage, Kwikset, Weslock, Hamilton, DoralLock, Grandeur, Omnia, Fusion, Baldwin, KABA,  MUL-T-LOCK and AHI.
